subtitle: over rings of integers of number fields
summary: Is there an algorithm that decides whether a Diophantine equation has a solution? Over rings of integers of number fields the question stayed open for more than 50 years.
problem: Hilbert's 1900 question asks for an algorithm that decides whether any Diophantine equation is solvable. Matiyasevich answered no over ℤ in 1970.
The same question over general rings of integers of number fields stayed open for more than 50 years until its recent resolution, which Teamwork-LEAP formalized.
title: Hilbert's tenth problem
